description:
Epoch Community Web opens into a community with its own channels (Discord-like),
  with Network Feed discovery and linked repository projects as secondary planes.

elements.name: Spectator replay hides private identity and protected input

I enter the community board

elements.name: Contributor searches registered sources and sees completeness

steps.name: Community Web has authorized Entities from current and stale registered sources
I run the deterministic search "state:needs-review"
results identify their canonical targets and source provenance
source completeness names the stale source without invoking AI

elements.name: Contributor corrects a precise search syntax error without AI

steps.name: I open the Community Web query workbench by keyboard
I enter an unsupported field and operator
the diagnostic identifies line column span code and field suggestions
no partial search or AI translation runs

elements.name: Maintainer explains why an Entity matched

steps.name: a deterministic search returned an authorized Entity
I open Search Explain
I can inspect normalization source pushdown residual evaluation authorization ordering and omissions
the explanation does not reveal unreadable Entities

elements.name: Contributor saves search semantics as a Projection Definition

steps.name: I preview an authorized deterministic search
I save it as the "needs-review" projection
the Projection Definition stores the typed Search Expression and total order
reopening it preserves canonical Entity identity rather than a copied result tree

elements.name: Contributor clones and reorganizes the built-in namespace

steps.name: I clone "builtin:default" into my own Projection Definition
I group project Entities by state and preview the tree
the preview uses authorized real data and deterministic collision names
the namespace diff explains changes before I mount them

elements.name: Contributor replaces the root and recovers from an invalid projection

steps.name: I mount my valid Projection Definition at root with user replace precedence
a later edit makes that Projection Definition invalid
the invalid definition is quarantined and exportable
I can open "/.epoch/default" and reset my user namespace entirely by keyboard

elements.name: Maintainer composes a projection and explains deterministic shadowing

steps.name: the built-in root and a community Projection Definition contain the same child name
I mount the community definition before the built-in root
first-match lookup selects the higher-precedence Projection Entry
Namespace Explain identifies the ordered components and shadowed entry

elements.name: One canonical Entity appears at multiple paths and occurrences

steps.name: one Entity is selected by two branches of one Projection Definition
I locate that Entity in the mounted namespace
both Projection Entries have distinct stable occurrence IDs and paths
both entries target the same canonical object ID

elements.name: Queued projection updates preserve the reader's position

steps.name: I am reading one Projection Entry in queued update mode
a source change adds an earlier-sorting Entity
Community Web announces the queued count without moving focus or reading anchor
I apply queued updates
focus remains attached to the prior occurrence or canonical target

elements.name: Private Entities cannot influence observable search or paths

steps.name: two corpora differ only by Entities I am not authorized to read
I compare search hits counts facets suggestions completions paths collisions and explanations
every observable authorized result is equivalent
source status reveals at most a generic unauthorized omission

elements.name: Browser falls back when persistent SQLite is unavailable

steps.name: my browser cannot provide the required OPFS and FTS5 capabilities
I open a metadata-only Community replica and search
Community Web reports the unavailable persistence capability
the Orama or reference backend remains functional without losing canonical data

elements.name: Two browser tabs contend without corrupting the search index

steps.name: two Community Web tabs open the same browser search replica
both attempt a local index update
one writer coordinates the update and the other waits or falls back explicitly
reopening the replica returns the same authorized Entities and checkpoint

elements.name: Projection state survives reload and deterministic migration

steps.name: persisted schema 2 contains stable Entity IDs and a saved query record
Community migrates and reloads the state
one current Projection Definition preserves the IDs timestamps query semantics and aliases
rerunning migration produces the same state without a compatibility API

elements.name: GraphQL and text frontends share one Search Expression

steps.name: a structured GraphQL search and text search express the same authorized predicate
I execute both against one Search Snapshot
both return the same canonical targets in the same total order
GraphQL uses keyset cursors rather than array offsets

elements.name: CLI user validates and previews a Projection Definition

steps.name: I have a Projection Definition JSON file
I validate and preview it with epoch-community
the CLI reports deterministic JSON diagnostics and Projection Entries
invalid cycles fail without saving or mounting the definition

elements.name: Contributor splits a change graph atomically and reconstructs the exact snapshot

steps.name: a convergence workbench with changes "base,api,ui" and dependencies "api>base,ui>api"
I split "api" into "api-schema,api-runtime" at unambiguous file boundaries
the change graph contains both atomic changes in dependency order
reconstructing the change graph produces the original snapshot digest

elements.name: Contributor gets a safe failure when an atomic split is ambiguous

steps.name: a convergence workbench with an inseparable edit in "shared.ts"
I try to split the edit into "schema,runtime"
the split is rejected without changing the change graph
the workbench explains the ambiguous hunk that needs a human boundary

elements.name: Maintainer follows stable revisions across multiple heads and supersession

steps.name: a change with two concurrent revision heads
I open its revision history
both heads retain stable revision identities
the superseded revision remains visible without becoming current

elements.name: Maintainer reviews a bundle without losing individual change context

steps.name: a review bundle for a three-change graph
I traverse cumulative and per-change review by keyboard
the selected change remains synchronized with the review detail
the gate matrix distinguishes current passing stale and missing evidence

elements.name: Maintainer partially merges only a dependency-closed subset

steps.name: a change graph where "ui" depends on "api" and "api" depends on "base"
I request a partial merge through "api"
the merge preview includes "base,api" and excludes "ui"
the merge control explains dependency closure before confirmation

elements.name: Maintainer squashes a change graph without erasing provenance

steps.name: a dependency-closed merge preview for "base,api"
I confirm a squash with maintainer authority
the squash records both source changes and their revisions
the resulting change has a new stable identity

elements.name: Maintainer cannot merge with stale review evidence

steps.name: an approved review for an older revision
a new revision supersedes the approved revision
merge remains blocked with an unmistakable stale approval explanation

elements.name: Contributor resolves a durable conflict after deterministic help precedes AI

steps.name: a durable unresolved conflict with base left and right identities
deterministic resolution cannot resolve it
the conflict remains first-class and actionable
an AI resolution proposal arrives and I later confirm a human resolution
the AI proposal remains untrusted and the human resolution closes the conflict

elements.name: Contributor hydrates a partial browser replica and sees truthful copy isolation

steps.name: an offline browser replica with promised objects and a copy-on-write workspace

elements.name: Contributor keeps stable mappings while escaping through interoperable forges

steps.name: a change mapped to jj and a continuous mirror with an F3 escape archive

elements.name: Maintainer sponsors a finite-budget agent and later revokes it

steps.name: an agent principal with its own key sponsored by a maintainer grant

allocated reserved consumed released and expired amounts are distinguishable
the sponsor revokes the grant
new agent work is denied with the principal sponsor grant and budget reason

elements.name: Responder archives a public release but denies a private archive request

steps.name: a public release with an SWHID and a private raw session

archive status is remote-confirmed for the public release
the private archive request is denied without exposing the raw session

elements.name: Screen-reader maintainer traverses the change graph at mobile width and 200 percent zoom

tree and list focus identify the same selected change and revision
at 200 percent zoom the workbench has no horizontal page overflow
